preguntas.respuesta: A platform that gives a sports club the means to find sponsors and the means to keep them: a page that shows its real value, a catalogue of priced opportunities, a sponsorship pack ready to send and a record of what it promises each business. The club decides who to approach; any business that lands on its page can contact it directly.

preguntas.pregunta: Does ApoyaClub find businesses for me?
preguntas.respuesta: No, and it's worth being clear about it: you approach the businesses, because you're the one who knows your area and the people in it. What ApoyaClub does is make sure that approach has something behind it —a serious page, a sponsorship pack in one click, a price you can defend— and that it doesn't fall apart afterwards: what you've promised each business, whether it's done, and a report to show them when it's time to renew.

preguntas.pregunta: How much does it cost for a club?
preguntas.respuesta: The first month is free. After that, €29.90/month including VAT, with no surprises in the price.
Yes, and they don't even need to create an account. Finding clubs, viewing their pages and contact details and writing to them costs nothing.

preguntas.pregunta: Does ApoyaClub take any commission on the sponsorship?
preguntas.respuesta: No, the commission is 0%. The club and the business negotiate and agree the terms directly between themselves.
ApoyaClub doesn't handle payments or act as an agency: payment and the rest of the deal are handled directly between the club and the business, in whatever way you both decide.

preguntas.pregunta: Can I cancel whenever I want?
preguntas.respuesta: Yes. From the club dashboard you can cancel your subscription whenever you like, and you'll keep access until the end of the period you've already paid for.

faq.fiscalidadTexto: A sponsorship deal between a club and a business may have tax implications (VAT, invoicing, deductions…) for both parties. ApoyaClub doesn't handle payments or act as an agency, and <fuerte>doesn't provide tax advice</fuerte>: we recommend you speak to a tax adviser or accountant before closing any deal.

seguimiento.texto: The reason a local sponsor almost never renews isn't the price: it's that in June they can't say what they got for their money. ApoyaClub gives you somewhere to note it down and the means to prove it.

embudo.descartadaTexto: If the business wasn't a good fit, you set it aside and it stops getting in the way. It isn't deleted: next year it might interest you again.

preguntas.respuesta: No. Not for browsing, writing to a club, signing up or publishing what you offer. ApoyaClub is paid for by clubs through their subscription; for a business or a partner it's free.

preguntas.pregunta: Do you take a commission on what I give the club?
preguntas.respuesta: No. Whatever you agree with the club is between you, and the money never goes through us.

preguntas.pregunta: Do I need to sign up to contact a club?
preguntas.respuesta: No. You go to the club's page, fill in the contact form and the club receives your message. You only need an account if you want clubs to find you.

preguntas.pregunta: I don't have a budget, but I can provide a service. Does that work?
preguntas.respuesta: It does, and it's what's needed most. Many clubs publish exactly what they need —a coach, a physio, equipment— instead of asking for money. Look for it under "what clubs need".

preguntas.pregunta: How do I know the club really exists?
preguntas.respuesta: Each club fills in its page with its teams, facilities and details, and replies to your message itself. If something doesn't add up, write to us and we'll look into it.

preguntas.pregunta: Can I remove my profile from the directory?
preguntas.respuesta: Whenever you like, from your dashboard, with a checkbox. You stop appearing and your offers are hidden along with it.
